method: Fresh medium114012 original-source review: all131 full-width Piano contexts rendered at172.8dpi with source-coordinate rulers and original Auto edges; every proposed top/bottom edge rechecked in a separate source strip. 22 conservative source-bound refinements then rerendered and checked. Protected rectangles preserve complete grand staves, own notes, ledger lines, articulation dots, beams, slurs/ties, dynamics, piano tempo text, octave/pedal indications, fermatas, barlines and gutter numbers with approximately1–2pt margin. No masks. This map is independent of the previous lightly-skewed edition map. Suggested rectangles are source-review references; retain Auto unless a guard fails or neighboring context is materially excessive.
